EC1: Estimated GFR [OR] (eGFR) < 60 mL/min/1.73 m2 and blood glucose [OR] > 135 mg/dl; Past or present history of acute renal failure [OR], renal dialysis [OR], diabetes mellitus.
EC2: Women  [OR]who received metallic fixation, [OR] coronary artery stent in recent 3 months; or women  [OR]who received mechanical valve replacement that is not compatible with MR magnet; or women with aneurysmal clips, [OR] pacemakers.
EC4: Women who are pregnant or who are planning to be pregnant, or who are lactating (though the possibility in our target population should be very low)
EC5: Past history of breast cancer within recent 5 years before the currently diagnosed breast cancer.
EC6: Women who received chemotherapy for other disease entity in recent 1 year.
EC7: Women who cannot cooperate with the examinations.
